name: Sample Ichor
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Sample Ichor bears traces of necromancy and warlock sorcery. Apothecary Renferrel refined it from the fluid that sustains the Rot Hide gnolls.

sections.title: Unraveling the Rot Hides
sections.body: Apothecary Renferrel sent Sample Ichor to the Undercity for closer study. He gathered it from the Rot Hide gnolls and their lingering remnants, then reduced the foul liquid to its base components. His findings showed that necromantic rites and warlock magic had shaped the ichor. Since its making reaches beyond simple alchemy, Renferrel sent it to Bethor Iceshard for divination.

faq.answer: Sample Ichor is an extract Apothecary Renferrel refined from the bodily fluids of the Rot Hide gnolls. He separated it into its base components to learn how magic had made the walking dead beasts.

faq.q: Who needs to see this sample?
aliases: who do i bring the ichor to
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard needs to examine Sample Ichor. He is an undead mage in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, skilled in divination and magical traditions that can reveal traces ordinary alchemy cannot discern.

faq.q: What kind of magic is inside the ichor?
aliases: what magic is in the ichor
faq.answer: Sample Ichor holds warlock and necromantic magic bound into its fluid. Bethor Iceshard says the vial bears powerful, ancient enchantments that need deeper divination to uncover fully.

faq.q: Why didn't the apothecaries finish analyzing it themselves?
aliases: why not renounce rot hide ichor
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society excels in alchemy, toxins, and bodily blights. Complex arcane weaves call for a sorcerer like Bethor Iceshard, who can identify magical schools and unravel esoteric spells beyond an apothecary's usual tools.

angles.text: As a warlock, you may recognize the warlock arts Apothecary Renferrel found woven with necromancy in the ichor. This hints that fel practices helped bind these undead beasts.
As a mage, you know the value of classical arcane study against dark sorcery. Bethor Iceshard uses specialized divination spells to read the residue in Sample Ichor.
